summary: This note describes Breakfast Creek, a small urban stream in Queensland, Australia. It is a tributary of the Brisbane River and runs through suburban Brisbane in the South East region. The note also gives the Aboriginal name of the creek, Barrambin.
one_line: Breakfast Creek is a small urban tributary of the Brisbane River in suburban Brisbane, Queensland, Australia.
key_facts: Breakfast Creek is a small urban stream.
Breakfast Creek is a tributary of the Brisbane River.
Breakfast Creek is located in suburban Brisbane.
Breakfast Creek is located in the South East region of Queensland, Australia.
The Aboriginal name of Breakfast Creek is Barrambin.
